text:
Hello to morning crew,

An experienced planner mentioned a detail about floor markings midweek, and I wanted to pass it on. Please keep the boarding path and waiting area clearly separated whenever the lounge is active, so families and pets can move through the space with confidence. The Companion Animal Travel Desk should continue to give clear guidance before departure, and the team should use the same calm, warm language with every traveler so no one feels rushed or uncertain. When questions come in, please answer them promptly and respectfully, and remember that each animal should receive patient attention from trained staff.

<<FACT F019>> In practical terms, that means we should stay attentive to signage, handoff flow, and the tone of every conversation at the counter. If you notice any scuffed markings, misplaced cones, or unclear directions, please report them right away so the next shift can correct the issue without delay. Small details matter here, because they help protect a smooth experience for travelers and support the care standards expected by Aurelia Skyways.

Thank you for keeping the desk steady, courteous, and well organized. Your attention to these details helps the whole operation feel reassuring for both people and pets.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
